bio.name: Nitin Kanzariya
paragraphs: I'm a passionate Full Stack Developer specializing in building modern, scalable web applications and cutting-edge AI-powered solutions. With expertise spanning React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, and Python FastAPI, I transform complex challenges into elegant, user-friendly solutions.

My unique blend of web development mastery and AI expertise allows me to create intelligent applications that leverage RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) chatbots, vector databases. I'm passionate about pushing the boundaries of what's possible with technology.

strengths: Expertise in building RAG-powered AI chatbots
